```{python}
#| label: setup
from paperfigs import data, fig_cost_convergence, fig_method_comparison

iterations = data.load_iterations()
runs = data.load_runs()

# 破棄 run(計測汚染・セッション切断: docs/COORDINATION.md 2026-07-16)と
# 進行中 run は載せない。掲載対象は編集判断としてここで明示する。
PAPER_SST_RUNS = ["run25", "run26", "run30"]

sst = runs[runs["run"].isin(PAPER_SST_RUNS) & runs["feasible"]]
best = sst.loc[sst["best_cost_usd_per_tCO2"].idxmin()]
best_cost = f"{best['best_cost_usd_per_tCO2']:.2f}"
best_run = best["run"]
best_purity = f"{best['best_CO2_purity']:.3f}"
best_recovery = f"{best['best_CO2_recovery']:.3f}"

bl = runs[(runs["kind"] == "baseline") & runs["feasible"]]
bl_best_cost = f"{bl['best_cost_usd_per_tCO2'].min():.2f}" if not bl.empty else "n/a"
```

# Results

The SST agent autonomously discovered feasible multi-stage membrane cascades.
The best configuration (`{python} best_run`) achieved a capture cost of
`{python} best_cost` \$/tCO~2~ at a purity of `{python} best_purity` and a
recovery of `{python} best_recovery`, whereas the best one-shot baseline
reached `{python} bl_best_cost` \$/tCO~2~ under the same wall-clock budget.

```{python}
#| label: fig-convergence
#| fig-cap: "Cost trajectory over SST iterations. Open circles mark iterations satisfying both purity and recovery constraints."
fig_cost_convergence(iterations, runs=PAPER_SST_RUNS)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Best feasible capture cost per campaign: SST versus one-shot optimization baselines."
fig_method_comparison(runs)
```

As shown in @fig-convergence, the outer-loop transitions move the search
into feasible basins that one-shot optimization fails to reach
(@fig-comparison).
